gamma.role: Creates presentations, documents and simple websites from a written prompt or an existing file.
gamma.audience: Students, teachers and independent creators who need a polished presentation or document fast, and teams and organizations.
pros: Right-to-left support: per the help center, Gamma supports RTL languages including Hebrew. You can prompt in Hebrew and text aligns right automatically.
Export to PowerPoint and PDF even on the free plan, plus basic import.
API access on higher plans: Pro and Ultra include API, custom domains and detailed view analytics.
cons: Free credits don't renew: you get 400 non-expiring credits at sign-up; 200 more per referral.
Free allows up to 10 slides per prompt; Plus raises it to 100.
'Made with Gamma' label on the free plan; Plus removes it.
gamma.price: Free plan with 400 one-time credits. Paid plan prices not verified.
gamma.free: Free plan: 400 non-expiring, non-renewing credits at sign-up, up to 10 slides per prompt, basic import, PPT and PDF export, basic image generation.
plans: 400 credits at sign-up, up to 10 slides per prompt, basic import, PPT/PDF export, basic image generation.
1,500 credits/month, up to 100 slides per prompt, removes 'Made with Gamma'.
4,000 credits/month, API, up to 10 custom domains, view analytics, headers and footers, password protection.
20,000 credits/month, API, up to 100 custom domains, custom fonts.
gamma.privacy: On personal accounts (Free, Plus, Pro, Ultra) content may be used by default to train and improve Gamma's models; opt out any time in Account Settings > Data Controls. Business, Enterprise and team content is excluded and the setting is locked.
gamma.watermark: Plus removes the 'Made with Gamma' label, so on Free it appears (inferred from the help page).
gamma.api: Yes. Included in Pro and Ultra per the help center. API docs not read.
gamma.hebrew: Per the help center, Gamma supports right-to-left languages including Hebrew, Arabic, Persian and Urdu. You can prompt in Hebrew or pick a language; text aligns right. Mixed RTL/LTR text may need manual fixes.
gamma.students: No official student discount found on the pricing or help pages read.
gamma.watch: Users report the AI says it changed a slide when it changed nothing, and that the refund window is only 3 days.

grammarly.role: Writing assistant that fixes grammar and spelling, suggests phrasing and generates text inside the apps and sites you write in.
grammarly.audience: Students, writers and professionals writing in English or other supported languages, alone or in an organization.
grammarly.status: Active. The company behind Grammarly renamed itself Superhuman; Grammarly continues as the writing product inside the Superhuman suite, and almost all existing features stay unchanged per the help center.
pros: 50% student discount: verified students (via SheerID) get 50% off Grammarly Pro for one subscription term, in a limited-time offer.
Free plan with a monthly quota: fixes mistakes, detects tone, 100 AI prompts a month. Pro raises it to 2,000 prompts per user per month.
Writing suggestions in 24 languages besides English, included on all plans including free.
cons: Hebrew is not among the 24 supported languages.
Rephrasing and originality check are paid only: tone change, full-sentence rewrite, AI detection and plagiarism check are not in the free plan.
Content is used for training by default: per the privacy policy Superhuman trains its AI models on collected data; you can control it in account settings.
grammarly.price: Pro is 12 USD/user/month billed annually, or 15 USD monthly. Free plan with 100 AI prompts a month.
grammarly.free: Free plan: fixes mistakes, tone detection and 100 AI prompts a month.
grammarly.trial: Pro has a free trial with an email reminder two days before it ends. Trial length not stated on the page read.
plans: Mistake fixes, tone detection, 100 AI prompts/month.
Tone change, sentence rewrite, AI detection and plagiarism check, 2,000 AI prompts per user/month.
Same as annual Pro.
grammarly.privacy: Per Superhuman's privacy policy (effective 16 Nov 2026), the company uses collected data to train its AI models, and the user can decide in account training settings whether their content is used. External AI providers are barred from training on customer content. Enterprise and education content is processed under the organization's contract.
grammarly.hebrew: Source does not mention Hebrew: the help article lists 24 writing-suggestion languages besides English and Hebrew is not among them. It mentions translation too, without a language list. Interface language not checked.
grammarly.students: Per the help center, students get 50% off Grammarly Pro in a limited-time offer after SheerID verification. It covers one subscription term, can't be combined with other discounts and doesn't apply to App Store or Google Play purchases.

quillbot.role: Writing toolkit: paraphrasing, grammar check, summarizing, AI-text detection and translation.
quillbot.audience: Students and writers working in English or supported languages who need paraphrasing, summarizing and checking.
pros: Paraphraser works in 23 languages; the translator covers 34 languages including Hebrew, per the help center.
Free plan with no credit card: paraphrase up to 125 words in two modes, summarize up to 1,200 words, limited AI detector.
One subscription for ten devices: Premium runs on up to 10 devices at once, with a refund up to 3 days for eligible new users.
cons: Hebrew only in the translator: paraphrasing, grammar check, summarizing and plagiarism check don't support it. Grammar check works in English, German, Spanish and French; summarizer in English only.
Free word limits: paraphrasing 125 words, summarizing 1,200 words, advanced Humanizer 3 uses.
Price varies by region: Premium price depends on region and local currency at checkout.
quillbot.price: Premium is 8.33 USD/month billed annually. Free plan exists.
quillbot.free: Free, no credit card: paraphrase up to 125 words in two modes, basic grammar fix, summaries up to 1,200 words, limited AI detection and 3 uses of advanced Humanizer.
plans: Paraphrase up to 125 words in two modes, basic grammar fix, summary up to 1,200 words, limited AI detection, 10MB storage.
Summaries up to 6,000 words, plagiarism check of 25,000 words/month, unlimited advanced Humanizer, 100MB storage, up to 10 devices at once.
quillbot.privacy: Not verified: privacy policy and terms not read.
quillbot.hebrew: Per the help center, Hebrew is supported only in QuillBot's translator (34 languages). The paraphraser supports 23 languages without Hebrew, grammar check English, German, Spanish and French, and summarizer, citations and plagiarism check English only. Interface language and RTL display not mentioned.
quillbot.students: The Premium page mentions no student discount.

beautiful-ai.role: Presentation builder that lays out design automatically with smart slide templates and generates content with AI.
beautiful-ai.audience: Students and professionals building presentations who want consistent design without manual layout.
pros: A free year for students: students with a valid .edu email get a year free, per the pricing page.
300+ smart slide templates: Pro includes AI content and image generation, translation, 300+ Smart Slide layouts, a theme builder and data visualization.
PowerPoint import and export are included in Pro.
cons: No permanent free plan: 14-day trial of Pro or Team, with a credit card and automatic charge if you don't cancel.
The student benefit needs a .edu email; Israeli institutions usually end in ac.il. Not checked whether accepted.
Pro is annual billing on the page; the monthly alternative is a single project at 45 USD.
beautiful-ai.price: Pro is 14.50 USD/month billed annually, or 45 USD monthly. No free plan; 14-day trial. Free year of Pro for students with a .edu email.
beautiful-ai.trial: 14-day trial of Pro or Team. Credit card required; charged automatically if you don't cancel before the end.
plans: AI content and images, writing help, translation, 300+ Smart Slide layouts, theme builder, data visualization, embedded media, PowerPoint import and export.
Same as annual Pro.
beautiful-ai.privacy: Not verified: privacy policy not read.
beautiful-ai.hebrew: Not verified: no language page or help article on Hebrew and right-to-left was read. The pricing page mentions translation without a language list.
beautiful-ai.students: Verified students with a .edu email get a free annual Beautiful.ai Pro subscription, per the official education page. Not checked whether non-US institutions (such as ac.il) are accepted.

deepl.role: Machine translator for text and files, with a phrasing-improvement tool (DeepL Write).
deepl.audience: Students, translators and professionals working in several languages, including Hebrew.
pros: Translation to and from Hebrew: per the help center, Hebrew is supported in the next-gen model, with glossary, tone choice and alternatives.
50,000 characters a month free: the free version includes 50,000 characters per user per month and one file translation a month up to 5MB.
Paid versions don't train on text: per the privacy policy, DeepL Pro, API Pro and Write Pro texts aren't used to improve the service.
cons: Free versions train on your text: content uploaded to the free Translator and Write, and its corrections, is used to train and improve DeepL's networks.
One file a month free, up to 5MB, and one glossary with 5 entries per language pair.
Write Pro is sold separately at 6.99 EUR/user/month billed annually.
deepl.price: Individual is 7.49 EUR/month billed annually, incl. VAT per the German price list. Free version with 50,000 characters a month.
deepl.free: Free: 50,000 characters per user per month, one file translation a month up to 5MB, one glossary and one saved translation. Free-version texts are used for training.
plans: 50,000 characters per user/month, 1 file translation/month up to 5MB, 1 glossary with 5 entries per language pair, 1 saved translation.
deepl.privacy: Per the privacy policy, in the free Translator and DeepL Write the company processes content and translations for a limited time to train and improve its networks, including user corrections. In Translator Pro, API Pro and Write Pro texts aren't used to improve the service; the Pro page says content is stored only temporarily as technically needed, then deleted, never used for training.
deepl.api: Yes. The privacy policy mentions DeepL API Pro, where texts aren't used to improve the service. API prices and docs not read.
deepl.hebrew: Per the help center, Hebrew is supported in the next-gen translation model, with glossary, tone and alternatives. The article doesn't mention DeepL Write in Hebrew, the interface language or right-to-left display.
deepl.students: Not checked. The pricing page read mentioned no student discount.

jasper.role: Marketing-content platform with AI agents that write in the company's brand voice.
jasper.audience: Marketing teams and marketing content writers in companies, less students.
pros: Brand voice: Pro includes 2 brand voices, 5 knowledge assets and 3 audiences; Business removes the limits.
Agents for marketing workflows: Pro has basic workflow agents; Business adds translation and research agents and no-code agent building.
API on the Business plan: API access is included only in Business.
cons: No free plan: only a 7-day Pro trial.
High price for a single user: Pro is 69 USD/user/month billed monthly, or 59 USD billed annually with a 12-month commitment.
Business is quote-priced and starts with a 12-month commitment.
jasper.price: Pro is 69 USD/user/month billed monthly, or 59 USD billed annually. No free plan; 7-day trial.
plans: One seat, Canvas, marketing workflow agents, 2 brand voices, 5 knowledge assets, 3 audiences.
One seat, Canvas, marketing workflow agents, 2 brand voices, 5 knowledge assets, 3 audiences.
jasper.privacy: Per Jasper's trust page, company data and outputs are never used to train third-party language models. The page doesn't say whether Jasper itself trains models on content.
jasper.api: Yes. API is included in Business. The trust page also points to Jasper APIs, Jasper MCP and Image APIs. Docs not read.
jasper.hebrew: Source does not mention Hebrew: the pricing and trust pages don't list supported languages.
jasper.students: No student discount found on the pricing page.

napkin-ai.role: Turns text into editable, exportable diagrams, infographics and business illustrations.
napkin-ai.audience: Students, lecturers and professionals who want to turn text into a diagram for a presentation or document.
pros: Weekly free credits: the free plan includes 500 credits a week, charged at about one credit per word selected for generation.
Unlimited PNG and PDF export on the free plan, and unlimited import of PPT, DOC, PDF, HTML and MD files.
PPT and SVG export on paid plans: Plus adds unlimited PPT and SVG export and removes Napkin branding.
cons: Napkin branding on free visuals.
No student discount: the pricing page says explicitly there are currently no discounts for students or non-profits.
napkin-ai.price: Plus is 12 USD/user/month billed monthly, or 9 USD billed annually. Free plan with 500 credits a week and Napkin branding.
napkin-ai.free: Permanent Free plan: 500 credits a week, unlimited PNG and PDF export and file import. Visuals carry Napkin branding.
plans: 500 credits/week, unlimited PNG and PDF export, unlimited file import.
10,000 credits/month, no branding, unlimited PPT and SVG export, team and billing management.
10,000 credits/month, no branding, unlimited PPT and SVG export, team and billing management.
30,000 credits/month, everything in Plus.
30,000 credits/month, everything in Plus.
napkin-ai.privacy: Per the pricing FAQ, on self-serve accounts Napkin may use anonymized interaction data to improve its AI; opt out in account settings. Enterprise customer data isn't used for training. The company states SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001 and GDPR. Full privacy policy not read.
napkin-ai.rights: Per the pricing FAQ, generated content stays the user's even after cancelling. The page doesn't address commercial use explicitly; terms not read.
napkin-ai.watermark: On the free plan visuals carry Napkin branding. Plus and Pro remove it.
napkin-ai.hebrew: Source does not mention Hebrew: the pricing page lists no supported languages, and the site's language menu has English, Spanish, French, Italian, Korean and Portuguese only.
napkin-ai.students: No student discount. Pricing page: "We don't currently offer discounts to non-profits or students."

wordtune.role: Writing assistant that suggests alternative phrasings, fixes spelling and grammar and summarizes texts.
wordtune.audience: Students and writers who want to improve phrasing of short English texts.
pros: 30% student discount: students, educators and non-profits get 30% off monthly and annual plans with an academic email or proof of study, by contacting support.
Unlimited plan with a trial: shown at 9.99 USD/month, or 6.99 USD/month billed annually, with a 3-day trial.
Unlimited spelling and grammar checking on the free plan, plus 10 rewrites and AI suggestions a day and 3 summaries a month.
cons: Only 10 rewrites a day on the free plan, 3 summaries a month.
The student discount needs a manual request: contact support with a .edu academic email or proof of study or employment.
wordtune.price: Advanced is 13.99 USD/month billed monthly, or 6.99 USD/month billed annually (regular prices, promotions possible). Free plan with 10 rewrites a day.
wordtune.free: Free Basic plan: 10 rewrites and AI suggestions a day, 3 summaries a month, unlimited spelling and grammar fixes.
plans: 10 rewrites and AI suggestions/day, 3 summaries/month, unlimited spelling and grammar fixes.
30 rewrites and AI suggestions/day, 15 summaries/month, AI recommendations, unlimited spelling and grammar fixes.
Same as monthly Advanced.
Unlimited rewrites, AI suggestions and summaries, vocabulary, clarity and fluency improvements, priority support.
Same as monthly Unlimited.
wordtune.privacy: Not verified: privacy policy not read.
wordtune.hebrew: Source does not mention Hebrew: the plans page lists no supported languages, and no official language page was read.
wordtune.students: 30% off monthly and annual plans for students, educators and employees of academic institutions and non-profits. Needs a .edu email or proof of study or employment; contact support.
